subject: science

stem.en: A cell near a root tip is watched over several days. Which observation shows best that the cell has differentiated, and has not only grown larger?

text.en: It became larger than it was before.

feedback.en: A cell can grow larger and still be a cell that divides. Size alone does not show a change in structure and function.

text.en: It was pushed farther away from the root tip by the new cells formed near the tip.

feedback.en: Moving away from the tip is where differentiation often happens, but the move itself does not show that the cell has changed.

text.en: It took in more water than before.

feedback.en: Taking in water can make a cell bigger, but it does not show that the cell has stopped dividing or taken on a job.

text.en: It stopped dividing and changed its shape and wall to suit one job.

explanation.en: Growth changes the size of a cell. Differentiation is different: the cell loses the ability to divide and changes in structure and function, so that it can do one particular job, such as support, transport or storage.

hints.en: Which change could not happen just by the cell getting bigger?

tags: Differentiation is only a change in size or shape
